title: Plan Reclassification After a Certifying Borrower's Death — Occupancy and Residency Certification Desk Reference
content:
When a certifying borrower dies and the loan continues, an Occupancy and Residency Certification profile is moved to a new certification plan, and the open certification cycle is given a number of response days. This reference governs those response days.

## Scope of the reclassification

When a profile is reclassified after a certifying borrower's death, the plan it moves to is the plan named in the plan's reclassification setting for its current plan, and the move rests on an accepted death notice on file for the profile. An open cycle whose due date has already passed is re-dated under this rule; an open cycle whose due date has not passed keeps its due date.

## The action and its effect

The servicing agent changes the plan recorded on the profile to the plan named and sets the due date of the open certification cycle to the date that lies the given number of calendar days after today. Nothing else on the profile changes: its status, last certification, absence details and enrollment stay as they were. The death notice the change rests on is cited in the receipt.

## Invocation

`reclassify_occupancy_plan_0e562024` is an agent-side tool: the servicing agent unlocks it and then calls it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `residency_profile_id` | reference number of the occupancy certification profile being moved, as returned by the occupancy profile lookup for the borrower | identifier |
| `residency_submission_id` | reference number of the accepted death notice on file for this profile, as returned by the occupancy submission lookup | identifier |
| `variant_name` | the certification plan the profile moves to | one of the six plan names below, written exactly |
| `response_days` | the calendar days from today to the due date the open certification cycle is to carry after the move | integer written without decimals; negative when that due date lies before today |

Values accepted for `variant_name`, as the tool describes each plan:

- "Standard Annual Certification" — one living borrower remains and certifies alone;
- "Joint Borrower Certification" — two or more living borrowers remain and each certifies;
- "Non-Borrowing Spouse Household Certification" — a living borrower and an eligible non-borrowing spouse remain and both certify;
- "Deferral Period Certification" — no borrower remains and the eligible non-borrowing spouse certifies while the loan is in its deferral period;
- "Living Trust Certification" — title is held in a living trust and the trustee and each living borrower certify;
- "Authorized Representative Certification" — an attorney-in-fact or guardian certifies for the borrower.

## Receipt

On success the tool returns one line of the form "Profile <profile reference> moved to <plan>; open cycle due <new due date YYYY-MM-DD>; death notice <notice reference>." Its presence, rather than a line beginning "Error", means the profile now carries the new plan and the new due date.
